name: Pop Quiz

gist.Great Detective Doq: When he attacks she takes a random card from your hand and names a card type. If she is right the attack hits much harder and she draws two.
gist.Timeless King Zi: Spends the Action to show three different spells from her deck; YOU choose which one he casts, whatever its level. The other two are deleted.
gist.Friedhelm, the Misled Avenger: Spends the Action to play an Attack or Spell straight out of the deck as though from hand. He can never do more than one thing a turn.
gist.I Found You!: Discards a random card from your hand: a spell or attack means a hit, an artifact or potion she keeps, an Ability she attaches to her own hero. Free while you hold six or more cards.
gist.Surefire Shot: An attack that can aim at anything and cannot be reduced, cancelled or reacted to.
gist.Icy Grave: Freezes a target for two turns.
gist.Poisoned Well: A stack of poison on everything you control.
gist.Thieving Strike: An attack that takes a random card from your hand.
gist.Hammer Throw: An attack; for a turn every artifact you play costs you a card.
gist.Premonition: Ability: puts chosen cards on top of her deck and ends her turn — so Friedhelm and Zi know what is coming.

plan: Every turn Shirin sets a question. Doq guesses what is in your hand — and a hand like Rowan's is mostly spells and Abilities, so she guesses well. Zi lays out three spells and makes you choose which one hits you. Friedhelm takes whichever attack answers the board straight out of the deck, so she never draws badly. There is no engine, no creature, and no defence beyond a few shields: three honest heroes doing one thing a turn. A full hand makes her better, a small or mixed one makes her ordinary, and she has nothing that deals with an attachment already in play.

looks.early: Fighting going onto Doq and Friedhelm; Zi fanning three spells for you to pick from.
looks.mid: Doq naming a card type before each swing; an Icy Grave on your caster.
looks.late: Friedhelm reaching into the deck for exactly the attack that finishes.

opening.tell: She attaches Fighting and takes one modest action a turn; there is nothing on her board.
opening.why: No engine to stop and nothing to sweep: the turns she spends on single hits are the turns the Storm needs. Keep your hand small and mixed so that Doq guesses badly.

midgame.tell: Zi fans three spells for you to choose from: Magic Hammer, Icy Grave, Poisoned Well.
midgame.why: You pick the least bad answer every time and deal with the one real hit a turn; a frozen caster is worse than a damaged one.

crisis.tell: Friedhelm fetches Surefire Shot out of the deck for a hero on its last legs.
crisis.why: It cannot be cancelled or reacted to, so shields do nothing: heal the target out of range first, or freeze Friedhelm, who only ever has the one Action.

endgame.tell: Doq is down; she is choosing between two heroes with one Action each.
endgame.why: One action a turn against three zaps: the arithmetic is yours.

opening.board: Shirin attaches Fighting to Friedhelm and asks, pleasantly, how many cards you are holding.
